title: Layout_05

location.note: Visually repeats the no-panel composition in DBV21, but the source explicitly teaches its DOOH application here.

slide_intent: Make an outdoor screen message legible as a sequence because a passerby may see only part of its cycle.
strategic_value: The direct white headline and red Schwelle can connect a brief DOOH encounter to DB’s identity.
demonstration: An employee photograph supports a white logo and headline with small copy and a red Schwelle; the source identifies this version as a DOOH format.
practical_value: Use this as the DOOH application of the no-panel layout and assess which elements remain clear during a brief glance.
